The graph of \(f(x)=x^2\) has vertex \((0,0)\).  
The graph of \(g(x)\) has vertex \((2,0)\), so it is the graph of \(f(x)\) shifted \(2\) units to the right.

Replacing \(x\) with \(x-2\) gives the rightward shift:
\[
g(x)=f(x-2)=(x-2)^2.
\]

\[
\boxed{g(x)=(x-2)^2=x^2-4x+4}
\]
